intro: The Philippine economy is driven by services, money from workers abroad and electronics exports.

chapters.title: Call centres and remittances
text: The Philippines is one of the world's biggest centres for call centres and business services, thanks to its English speakers. Money sent home by overseas workers is a large part of the economy.
Electronics and semiconductors are the biggest exports.

chapters.title: Farms and seas
text: Rice, coconuts, bananas and pineapples are major crops, and the country is a big exporter of bananas. Fishing is important for millions of families.

keyTerms.meaning: Money sent home by workers abroad.
Companies paying others, often abroad, to do work for them.
